title: 雨停後的信（30秒副歌故事版）
style: 35mm warm cinematic Taiwanese urban romance, cozy amber cafe interior contrasting with rainy blue dusk turning into golden-hour sunset, anamorphic bokeh, photorealistic

lyrics.zh: Peace and love 把溫柔留給世界

scenes.prompt_zh: 微雨黃昏，女角推開溫暖木質咖啡廳大門走進店內。
scenes.flow_prompt_en: Smooth 35mm Steadicam tracking shot following the 25-year-old Taiwanese woman in a beige trench coat pushing open a warm wooden cafe door at rainy twilight and stepping inside, soft amber tungsten light spilling onto her face, natural realistic motion, 24fps film look, no text.

scenes.shot_type: 連續接龍・抬頭望向窗邊

lyrics.zh: Peace and love 把溫柔留給世界
讓每顆心都能找到停歇

scenes.prompt_zh: 延續上鏡尾幀，她收起雨傘抬頭環顧溫暖店內，視線望向右側靠窗木桌。
scenes.flow_prompt_en: Seamless continuation from the exact start frame: the same 25-year-old Taiwanese woman in the beige trench coat gently folds her clear umbrella, looks up across the cozy wooden cafe interior, and turns her gaze toward a corner window table on the right, smooth continuous camera glide, photorealistic 24fps, no text.

lyrics.zh: 讓每顆心都能找到停歇
Peace and love 就算路途有一些黑

scenes.prompt_zh: 延續上鏡尾幀，她走到靠窗木桌旁，伸手拿起桌上的牛皮紙信封。
scenes.flow_prompt_en: Seamless continuation from the exact start frame: the same 25-year-old Taiwanese woman walks calmly to the wooden corner table by the window, pauses softly, and reaches her right hand down to pick up a sealed kraft-paper envelope resting beside a warm ceramic coffee cup, smooth follow shot, photorealistic 24fps, no text.

scenes.shot_type: 反打重錨・近景拆信微笑

lyrics.zh: Peace and love 就算路途有一些黑

scenes.prompt_zh: 切近景反打重新錨定畫質，她拆開信封抽出手寫卡片，嘴角露出溫柔微笑。
scenes.flow_prompt_en: Intimate 35mm reverse-angle medium close-up at the wooden cafe window table: the 25-year-old Taiwanese woman in the beige trench coat carefully opens the kraft-paper envelope, pulls out a handwritten card, reads it quietly, and a gentle relieved smile softens her eyes under warm window light, photorealistic 24fps, no text.

scenes.shot_type: 連續接龍・仰望金色餘暉

lyrics.zh: 我們仍能為彼此點亮明天

scenes.prompt_zh: 延續上鏡尾幀，她轉頭望向玻璃窗外，雨剛好停了，金色夕陽穿透雲層灑進來。
scenes.flow_prompt_en: Seamless continuation from the exact start frame: holding the handwritten card gently to her chest, she slowly turns her head toward the cafe glass window as outside rain stops and warm golden-hour sunset light breaks through the clouds, illuminating her hair and cheek, slow gentle tilt-up, photorealistic 24fps, no text.

scenes.section: 接龍・走出門迎向夕陽
scenes.shot_type: 連續接龍・推門離場拉遠

lyrics.zh: 我們仍能為彼此點亮明天

scenes.prompt_zh: 延續上鏡尾幀，她將信收進風衣口袋，推開咖啡廳門步入金色夕陽街道，鏡頭溫柔拉遠。
scenes.flow_prompt_en: Seamless continuation from the exact start frame: she tucks the card safely into her beige trench coat pocket, stands up with a hopeful smile, walks out the cafe exit onto the glowing golden-hour wet street as the camera gently pulls back in a peaceful closing shot, photorealistic 24fps, no text.
